title: ShopFlow: E-commerce Backend with Idempotent Checkout, Payments and AI Search
tagline: Build an online-shop backend that never oversells, never charges twice and never loses a payment, with AI as your pair programmer
description: Over nine phases you build ShopFlow like a professional team: requirements and threats, design with ADRs, a test-first implementation of a product catalog with full-text search, a server-side cart with coupons, money as integer paise, checkout with an Idempotency-Key and a guarded stock decrement that cannot oversell, orders with a state machine, HMAC-signed and de-duplicated payment webhooks, a transactional outbox, AI search assist and product description drafts with offline fallbacks, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Docker, optional free-tier deployment, observability, a payment-window migration and a retrospective. Pick Java, Python or TypeScript; the spec, database and tests are shared. Everything runs on your laptop, and the AI features work offline.

prerequisites.title: Git and the command line basics
One of: Java, Python or TypeScript fundamentals
REST APIs and HTTP status codes

outcomes: Turn a shop brief into testable requirements, user stories and a threat list (forged webhooks, double checkout, overselling, price tampering)
Design a REST API contract-first (OpenAPI) with a PostgreSQL schema, an order state machine and ADRs
Handle money correctly: integer paise end to end, exact coupon maths, database CHECK constraints
Prevent overselling with a guarded stock decrement and prove it with parallel checkout tests
Make checkout idempotent with an Idempotency-Key and payment webhooks safe with HMAC signatures and event de-duplication
Never lose an event between the database and a broker with a transactional outbox
Add AI search assist and description drafts whose output is validated and that fall back offline
Build CI/CD with GitHub Actions: matrix, caching, reusable workflows, service containers, GHCR
Add request IDs, JSON logs, metrics, a circuit breaker and an expand-only migration after a game day and a blameless post-mortem
Use AI assistants deliberately and verify every output
ai_feature: AI search assist (natural language to validated catalog filters) and product description drafts for the owner: offline rules/template by default, optional Ollama or a free Gemini/Groq key; checkout never depends on the AI
portfolio_blurb: Built ShopFlow, an e-commerce REST API: money as integer paise, a guarded stock decrement proven by parallel checkout tests (no overselling), idempotent checkout with Idempotency-Key, HMAC-signed and de-duplicated payment webhooks, a transactional outbox, optimistic locking, PostgreSQL full-text search with AI search assist and offline fallback, >=85 % test coverage, GitHub Actions CI/CD to GHCR, Docker, JSON logs, metrics, a circuit breaker added after a game day and an expand-only payment-window migration.
